verdict.rationale: The docs show the agent writing its own memory. With /remember, the agent itself decides where a lesson belongs and commits the update to MemFS, and background dreaming subagents consolidate and update memory. Memory is stored as Markdown files in a memory repository, which Letta staff describe as transparent and controllable. Search, however, needs the separately installed MemFS Search mod, and the evidence never documents the agent deleting memories or self-invoking named memory tools without a user prompt. Missing for 10: explicitly documented self-invoked memory tools/API (add/update/delete), built-in memory search without an add-on mod, evidence of deletion, independent hands-on corroboration.
